question: Let $f$ and $g$ be two functions defined on an interval $I$ such that $f(x)\ge0$ and $g(x)\le0$ for all $x\in I$, and $f$ is strictly decreasing on $I$ while $g$ is strictly increasing on $I$. Then

options.A: the product function $fg$ is strictly increasing on $I$
options.B: the product function $fg$ is strictly decreasing on $I$
options.C: the product function $fg$ is increasing but not necessarily strictly increasing on $I$
options.D: nothing can be said about the monotonicity of the product function $fg$

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level
